responsibility: Provides Matsushita MN10300 common target hooks for option handling, optimization defaults, and unwinding policy. It selects the target’s default bug/workaround-related flag set, chooses SJLJ exceptions, enables the STC block-reordering algorithm at higher optimization levels, and maps command-line processor-selection options like -mam33, -mam33-2, and -mam34 into the backend’s processor enum stored in gcc_options.
